title: The First Encounter
subtitle: High above the world
note: Author-supplied thundercloud prologue dialogue, lightly copyedited. The fight and subsequent cave scene are still being connected.
battle_intro: Lightning flashes around the two airborne fighters. The duel begins!

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Lightning crackles and the earth shakes as the two otherworldly beings face each other.

dialogue.speaker: ASMODEUS
dialogue.text: Too bad I have to kill ya. You're kinda cute, but the big guys have spoken, ya know.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: The mute angel raises her bow, signaling her response.
